summary: Iteration 46 - Wave Desktop Add-in Package Testing Complete. All add-in files verified: (1) plugin.json accessible at /wave-addin/plugin.json with correct name '58:12 Connect', version 1.0.0.1, and permissions (call.listen, call.dial, chat.send, chat.attach, meeting.manage, contact.manage), (2) wave-add-in-kit.js is the real Grandstream SDK (98KB), (3) index.html has complete UI with Dialer (dial pad + audio/video call buttons), Contacts tab, Meetings tab (instant/schedule/join), CRM tab with call log, (4) SDK initialization via onInitPluginWindowOk event, (5) Call event listeners (onRecvP2PIncomingCall, onAnswerP2PCall, onHangupP2PCall, onRejectP2PCall, onP2PCallCanceled), (6) DTMF during calls via pluginSDK.call.sendDTMF, (7) Wave page shows add-in card with preview link and installation instructions. Fixed CSS bug where active-call banner was visible when hidden.
critical_code_review_comments: plugin.json: Correct permissions for Wave add-in (call.listen, call.dial, chat.send, chat.attach, meeting.manage, contact.manage)
wave-add-in-kit.js: Real Grandstream SDK (98589 bytes) with pluginSDK global object
index.html: Complete add-in UI with 4 tabs (Dialer, Contacts, Meetings, CRM)
index.html: All call event listeners implemented (incoming, outgoing, answer, hangup, reject, cancel)
index.html: DTMF support via pluginSDK.call.sendDTMF during active calls
index.html: Meeting functions (quickStart, join, schedule) via pluginSDK.meeting
WavePage.jsx: Add-in card with preview link and installation instructions for Mac/Windows
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 46 verified Wave Desktop Add-in package. All static files at /wave-addin/ are accessible and correctly structured. The add-in uses pluginSDK from wave-add-in-kit.js (98KB real SDK). When running outside Wave Desktop (browser preview), it shows 'Preview Mode' status. The pluginSDK only works inside Wave Desktop app (Electron-based). Fixed CSS bug where .hidden class was overridden by .call-active display:flex - added !important to .hidden. WavePage.jsx has add-in download card with installation instructions.
